dmitri_sokolov.name: Dmitri Sokolov
dmitri_sokolov.private_context: Dmitri is selling a used kiln. He is asking 1400 and would rather close than keep looking. He knows Priya has offered 900.

priya_raghavan.name: Priya Raghavan
priya_raghavan.private_context: Priya wants to buy a used kiln. She has offered 900 and would rather close than keep looking. Her workshop lease renews on the 20th, and she needs the kiln before then.
